author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.97 shipped: Zone power and energy include zone-level loads
summary: Zone power and energy include zone-level loads
why: Zone sensors summed only rooms, so zone-level loads such as the zone AC circuits counted toward house coverage but never toward the zone's own watts or kWh. Adding them with a single no-double-count rule makes zone figures match what the house total already attributes, and restoring baselines prevents a mid-day restart from dropping a total_increasing value that the recorder would book as a meter reset.
implications: Shipped ZONE-LIVE-POWER-ROLLUP-1 at v5.103.97; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.97.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a zone energy value drops mid-day, if a zone-level entity is counted in two places, or if house coverage and zone totals disagree beyond overlap.

refs.release_notes: Zone total power, cost per hour, energy today and energy cost today add the zone's own loads on top of rooms, counting each entity once; zone energy survives mid-day restarts. Review SHIP after fix-up, name-diff clean.
